import os, re, sys
issues=[]

    p=os.path.join(d,'SKILL.md')
    if not os.path.isfile(p): continue
    txt=open(p, encoding='utf-8', errors='replace').read()
    m=re.match(r'^---\n(.*?)\n---\n', txt, re.S)
    if not m:
        issues.append(f"{d}: no parseable frontmatter"); continue
    fm=m.group(1)
    name=re.search(r'^name:\s*(.+)$', fm, re.M)
    desc=re.search(r'^description:\s*(.+)$', fm, re.M)
    if not name: issues.append(f"{d}: missing 'name' field")
    elif name.group(1).strip().strip('"\'') != d:
        issues.append(f"{d}: name mismatch -> '{name.group(1).strip()}'")
    if not desc: issues.append(f"{d}: missing 'description'")
    elif len(desc.group(1)) > 1024: issues.append(f"{d}: description >1024 chars ({len(desc.group(1))})")
print("\n".join(issues) or "frontmatter OK")
EOF
